algorithm: Resolve each selected norm ID to exactly one record in machine/CORE_CANON.json.
Reject a Personal Layer norm unless the current OperatorAcceptanceRecord explicitly accepts it in scope.
Project every normative field listed by normative_field_set without paraphrase.
Compute the normative-record hash and the resolved full-record hash.
Verify the corresponding semantic-record payload hash and Merkle inclusion proof.
Preserve selector order and reject missing, duplicate, extra, stale, or profile-mismatched records.
Set materialization_status to PASS only after every selected record is present and verified.
empty_selection: ERROR_FOR_EXECUTION_CONTEXT; permitted only in an unbound template
execution_precondition: Task execution is prohibited unless materialization_status = PASS_FULL_NORMATIVE_CONTENT_DELIVERED and the acceptance binding is CURRENT.

input_contract.operator_acceptance_record: exact runtime/operator_acceptance.json or current signed successor

output_contract: Task Capsule selected_norm_records contains one full normative projection for every selected_norm_id.
